### Bible Pathway - April 27
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-april-27-2013.html
Passage: 1 Kings 14:15
Points:
- Disobedience and unrepentant rebellion against God inevitably bring painful consequences.
- Israel repeatedly chose visible idols because they lacked trust in the invisible God.
- Scripture consistently warns that idolatry separates people from the Lord and invites judgment.
- Persistent national sin resulted in Israel being uprooted and scattered abroad.
- Walking closely with Christ protects believers from the destructive fallout of sin.
